text:
alex: Heads-up — saw the postmortem for yesterday. Quick proposal: introduce a weekly 'remediation ticker' (20m), and maintain a small set of failure-mode buckets to group recurring incidents. Thoughts?

maya: +1. Weekly 20m sync sounds good. Keep it async-friendly — notes + owners in a shared board.

nina: Can we be explicit about owner contact? Too many remediations listed as ‘infra’ with no followup. Owner + email/handle + a clear SLA plz.

sam: +1 to nina. Also propose a tiny timeline template we can paste into PMs: owner, due date, blockers, acceptance criteria. Maybe add a recurrence score field so we can sort by risk.

dave: Failure-mode buckets idea = yes. Suggest: capacity, routing, config, third-party, regression. That should help spotting pattern clusters across postmortems.

alex: Draft timeline template (one-line fields) — feel free to copy:
```
owner: @handle
due: YYYY-MM-DD
impact: (brief)
acceptance_criteria: (what passes)
blockers: (if any)
recurrence_bucket: (capacity|routing|config|third_party|regression)
recurrence_score: (0-5)
```

oncall-bot: NOTE: recurrence_score can be auto-populated from incidents service (if enabled). See /incidents api.

maya: Who will pilot this? Can we try the ticker + bucketization for 6 weeks and review outcomes?

sam: I can run the first 2 weeks as facilitator + create a GH project board for remediations. Will add cards using the template.

nina: Also recommend a comms cadence: initial summary to #product within 1h, status update at 2h (if ongoing), and a postmortem draft linked within 72h. Keeps stakeholders aligned.

dave: For IC rotation: rotate IC responsibility weekly among the oncall team, and maintain two backups. That reduces burnout and spreads institutional knowledge.

alex: Concrete action list:
- sam -> create GH project + board by Fri (use template)
- nina -> draft comms templates (1h, 2h, 72h) by Wed
- maya -> propose 3 meeting slots for weekly 20m by EOD Tue
- dave -> enumerate failure-mode buckets and map last 8 incidents by Fri
Trial length: 6 weeks, then retro.

sam: GH project created: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure-remediations (placeholder). Added initial cards for yesterday's postmortem.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks everyone.

alex: I'll add a single-line note to the postmortem linking this thread and the action items. Ping me if anyone is blocked.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "remediation-ticker kickoff" in 2 days for participants."
